speech_source: Free Spoken Digit Dataset (FSDD), human speech
initial_silence_policy: Fixed 0.30 s prefix removed before mixtures; no guaranteed initial silence.
selection_rule: Within each family: maximize validation mean SNR improvement, then mean SI-SDR improvement, then minimize degradation fraction and RTF.
caveat: The final operational split is not historically blind because all four environments were inspected in the earlier exploratory DEMAND round; no final-split values were used by this script to choose parameters.
